identity.name: Neuravex v0.1
identity.nature: Independent computer-vision architecture. Not a YOLO derivative or variant.
identity.primary_objective: maximize REAL detection AP/FLOP subject to minimum latency + VRAM + parameters + deployment cost

architecture_foundation.flow: Input -> Partial/Rep Backbone -> Multi-scale PAN/FPN -> Adaptive Compute -> Task Heads
architecture_foundation.backbone: Lightweight partial-channel reparameterizable backbone with RepConv branches, mathematically exact BN fusion, and depthwise partial channel efficiency
architecture_foundation.neck: Multi-scale Path Aggregation Network (PANet) fusing P3, P4, P5 into Q3, Q4, Q5 with zero redundant convolutions
architecture_foundation.adaptive_compute: Adaptive compute router with per-sample routing, explicit compute budgets, routing telemetry, static/expected/executed compute accounting, and deterministic full-compute fallback

heads.detection: Decoupled 2D classification + bounding box regression supporting both DFL (reg_max > 1) and Direct Regression (reg_max = 1)
heads.geometry_3d: Camera-aware 3D detection predicting (X,Y,Z), (L,W,H), yaw (sin/cos) with strict camera calibration verification
heads.segmentation: Semantic logits, boundary map, discriminative instance embeddings, mask quality, prototype masks (bypassed in det-only mode)
heads.depth: Dense metric depth map (Z = 1/rho) with valid-depth masking and calibrated camera geometry
heads.dem: Dense Elevation / Terrain model with explicit terrain != depth separation and metric elevation output

claim_policy.rule: Every reported number must carry an explicit classification tag. Estimates and references must never be converted into measured Neuravex results.

baseline_separation.OFFICIAL_REFERENCE: Published official baseline results (e.g., official published YOLO benchmarks with full specification)
baseline_separation.LOCAL_REPRO: Pinned official implementation/checkpoint reproduced locally under identical hardware and measurement protocols
